nodes.label: ExpCore
nodes.author: Iyan Sanjaya
nodes.rationale: Toolkit PDF Coretax for Windows: extracts Bukti Potong and Pajak Masukan PDFs to Excel and auto-renames Bupot PDFs. Version 1.2, Apache 2.0.

nodes.label: test_expcore.py (pemeriksaan parser dan keamanan nama file)
nodes.norm_label: test_expcore.py (pemeriksaan parser dan keamanan nama file)

nodes.label: Bagian A - Identitas Wajib Pajak yang Dipotong
nodes.rationale: Fields A.1 NPWP/NIK, A.2 Nama, A.3 NITKU. Sample values: 0436117337418000 / MITRACOLL SARANA JAYA.
nodes.norm_label: bagian a - identitas wajib pajak yang dipotong

nodes.label: Bagian B - Pemotongan/Pemungutan PPh
nodes.rationale: Fields B.1 Jenis Fasilitas (Tanpa Fasilitas), B.2 Jenis PPh (Pasal 23), B.3-B.7 kode objek pajak / objek pajak / DPP / tarif / PPh, B.8-B.9 dokumen dasar, B.10-B.11 instansi pemerintah and SP2D.

nodes.label: Bagian C - Identitas Pemotong/Pemungut PPh
nodes.rationale: Fields C.1 NPWP, C.2 NITKU, C.3 Nama Pemotong, C.4 Tanggal, C.5 Nama Penandatangan, C.6 Pernyataan. Sample pemotong: ADIRA DINAMIKA MULTI FINANCE TBK.

nodes.label: Kode Objek Pajak 24-104-18 (Jasa Perantara/Keagenan)
nodes.rationale: DPP 3.700.000, tarif 2%, PPh 74.000 - the numeric row the extractor must read from the table.

nodes.label: Tanda tangan elektronik BSrE-BSSN
nodes.rationale: Document is signed with an electronic certificate; no wet signature required, verifiable via QR code at tte.kominfo.go.id. Explains why the PDF carries a signature layer the text parser must ignore.

nodes.label: Modul Bukti Potong
nodes.rationale: Extracts nomor dokumen, masa pajak, NPWP/NIK, nama, status bukti, jenis PPh, objek pajak, DPP, tarif, PPh, dokumen dasar and pemotong data into !Hasil_Rekap_Bupot.xlsx.

nodes.label: Coretax DJP (target PDF generator)
nodes.rationale: Parsers are written against the fixed layout of Coretax DJP output; protected, corrupt, scanned-without-text-layer, or differently laid out PDFs can fail.

nodes.label: Kolom Folder Sumber
nodes.rationale: Added because recursive scanning merges many subfolders into one sheet; without the origin path a merged row cannot be traced back to its source PDF.

nodes.label: Log Audit Penamaan Bupot (CSV)
nodes.rationale: Every preview and apply run writes a timestamped CSV (Log_Penamaan_Bupot_Pratinjau_/Penerapan_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.csv) so renames stay auditable and reversible by hand.

nodes.label: Modul Pajak Masukan
nodes.rationale: Extracts pembeli, nomor faktur, rincian barang, harga, kuantitas, DPP, PPN and netto. PPN is computed with a hardcoded 12% rate, so output is wrong for any period with a different rate.

nodes.label: Pemindaian Subfolder (recursive PDF scan)
nodes.rationale: One parent folder is processed together with all subfolders into a single result, so per-client folder trees do not need one run each.

nodes.label: Penamaan Otomatis Bupot
nodes.rationale: Renames PDFs to 'Nama Pemotong - Nomor Bukti - Masa Pajak - Sifat - Status.pdf'. Preview-then-apply because renaming is destructive; incomplete PDFs are skipped and existing names are never overwritten (suffix '(2)' added instead).

nodes.label: Bukti Pemotongan/Pemungutan PPh Unifikasi (BPPU) - contoh
nodes.rationale: One-page sample Coretax DJP BPPU: Nomor 25004WOBY, Masa Pajak 01-2025, sifat TIDAK FINAL, status NORMAL. Serves as the reference layout for the Bupot parser and the rename format.

nodes.label: Pratinjau Nama (dry-run rename preview)
nodes.rationale: A separate preview step exists so a mis-parsed batch cannot silently destroy filenames; the user inspects the CSV log before clicking Terapkan Nama.

nodes.label: Tarif PPN tetap 12%
nodes.rationale: Pajak Masukan computes PPN from a fixed 12% rate rather than reading it per invoice; simple, but a known ceiling if the statutory rate or a facility rate differs.

nodes.label: Nuitka standalone build
nodes.rationale: Compiles ExpCore.py to a standalone Windows exe with tk-inter plugin and bundled icons. Build is slow because pandas and numpy are compiled too; an interrupted build leaves no ExpCore.dist/ at all.

nodes.label: Output Excel Terformat
nodes.rationale: Number formats, headers and auto column widths are applied so the sheet is usable without manual cleanup. Same-named output files are overwritten on the next run.

nodes.label: Membedakan masalah kode dan masalah build
nodes.rationale: Running ExpCore.py from source is the control experiment: if source works and the built exe does not, the fault is in the build pipeline, not the application code.
nodes.norm_label: membedakan masalah kode dan masalah build

nodes.label: Nuitka mem-bundle dari interpreter yang menjalankannya
nodes.rationale: Nuitka bundles from the running interpreter, not the project folder. A missing dependency only warns, then still produces an .exe that crashes on launch, which is why every documented command uses the explicit venv path and why a verification import check precedes the build.
nodes.norm_label: nuitka mem-bundle dari interpreter yang menjalankannya

nodes.label: Tulis path dengan garis miring /
nodes.rationale: Forward slashes work in both PowerShell and Git Bash. Backslashes are escape characters in Git Bash, so .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe collapses to ..venvScriptspython.exe and fails with 'command not found'.

nodes.label: Panggil ./.venv/Scripts/python.exe secara eksplisit
nodes.rationale: Bare 'python' resolves through PATH and can hit the global, Microsoft Store, conda or another tool's venv interpreter even when the venv appears activated; the explicit path removes that whole class of failure.

nodes.label: Verifikasi isi ExpCore.dist sebelum installer
nodes.rationale: Listing ExpCore.dist for pdfplumber/pdfminer/pandas/numpy/customtkinter catches a wrong-interpreter build before packaging. Cleaning ExpCore.build/ does not help because stale artifacts are not the cause.

nodes.label: --windows-console-mode=disable dan diagnosis crash senyap
nodes.rationale: Console is disabled so end users get no stray terminal, but a startup crash then shows nothing at all. Trade-off is handled by redirecting stderr to a file, or temporarily switching to --windows-console-mode=force for test builds.

nodes.label: Disclaimer of Warranty and Limitation of Liability (Sections 7-8)
nodes.rationale: Work is provided AS IS with no warranties and no contributor liability, which is what makes an unpaid tax-document parser distributable at all.
nodes.norm_label: disclaimer of warranty and limitation of liability (sections 7-8)

nodes.label: Grant of Patent License (Section 3)
nodes.rationale: Patent grant terminates if the licensee files patent litigation over the Work, a defensive-termination trade-off in exchange for the irrevocable royalty-free grant.

nodes.label: Redistribution Conditions (Section 4)
nodes.rationale: Redistribution requires shipping the license, marking modified files, retaining attribution notices, and propagating any NOTICE file.

nodes.label: Non-standard appendix note about Eclipse Public License
nodes.rationale: The appendix contains a sentence not present in the canonical Apache 2.0 text, advising also obtaining an 'Eclipse Public License' if hosting the code. Provenance and intent unclear; flagged for review.
nodes.norm_label: non-standard appendix note about eclipse public license

nodes.label: Pemrosesan Sepenuhnya Lokal
nodes.rationale: Tax documents contain NPWP and counterparty data; ExpCore never uploads PDFs or extraction results to the internet, which is what makes it usable on client data.

nodes.label: Icon Visual Identity Choice
nodes.rationale: The mark is a single flat-line document outline (rounded rectangle with a clipped top-right corner, i.e. a dog-eared page/PDF sheet) whose right edge is broken by an outward-pointing chevron. The chevron punching through the page border reads as 'data leaving the document' — the extraction/export action that names the product (ExpCore = Export Core, a PDF data-extraction tool). Rendered as a stroke-only monoline glyph on a flat dark-navy square with a light periwinkle accent so it stays legible at small Windows taskbar/installer sizes and matches the application's dark UI theme rather than a light-mode system tray look.
